problem_statement: The WES release gateway retired the v1 `release(wave_id, zone, stops, rush=...)` call during last night's cutover; it now only accepts `submit(ReleaseOrder)` and answers with a `ReleaseReceipt` (or raises `ReleaseRejected`). Since then every wave `TargetRunner` tries to release fails with an AttributeError and the release queue is backing up. Please migrate `picking/runner.py` to the v2 API, following the example adapter the WES team left in `reference/`. Receipts flagged as duplicates mean the WES already holds the wave, so they should be reported as released with detail "duplicate". The failing tests in `tests/test_runner.py` describe the expected behaviour.

During last night's cutover, the WES release gateway dropped support for the v1 `release(wave_id, zone, stops, rush=...)` call. It now accepts only `submit(ReleaseOrder)`, which returns a `ReleaseReceipt` or raises `ReleaseRejected`. As a result, every wave that `TargetRunner` attempts to release now fails with an AttributeError, and the release queue is piling up. Please port `picking/runner.py` to the v2 API, using the example adapter the WES team left in `reference/` as a guide. A receipt flagged as a duplicate means the WES already has the wave, so it should be reported as released with detail "duplicate". The expected behaviour is captured by the failing tests in `tests/test_runner.py`.

`TargetRunner` can no longer release waves: since last night's cutover, the WES release gateway has retired the v1 `release(wave_id, zone, stops, rush=...)` call and only accepts `submit(ReleaseOrder)`, responding with a `ReleaseReceipt` (or raising `ReleaseRejected`). Every release attempt now throws an AttributeError, and the release queue is backing up. We need `picking/runner.py` migrated to the v2 API; the WES team left an example adapter in `reference/` to follow. When a receipt is flagged as a duplicate, the WES already holds the wave, so report it as released with detail "duplicate". See the failing tests in `tests/test_runner.py` for the expected behaviour.

Last night's cutover removed the v1 `release(wave_id, zone, stops, rush=...)` call from the WES release gateway. The only accepted entry point is now `submit(ReleaseOrder)`, which answers with a `ReleaseReceipt` or raises `ReleaseRejected`. Ever since, each wave release attempted by `TargetRunner` fails with an AttributeError, and releases are queuing up. Please update `picking/runner.py` to use the v2 API, modelled on the example adapter the WES team provided in `reference/`. Duplicate-flagged receipts indicate the WES already holds the wave and must be reported as released with detail "duplicate". Expected behaviour is described by the currently failing tests in `tests/test_runner.py`.
